name: Resolution Slope
definition: For a nonempty binary class $C\subseteq\{0,1\}^n$, let $S=k[x_{i,0},x_{i,1}:i\in[n]]$ and $J_C=(m_c:c\in C)$, where $m_c=\prod_{i=1}^n x_{i,1-c_i}$. If $\beta_{i,j}(J_C)$ are the graded Betti numbers of this ideal, define $\lambda_k(C)=\max(\{1\}\cup\{(j-n)/i:i\geq1,\ \beta_{i,j}(J_C)\neq0\})$.
parameters: A coefficient field $k$; positive-step Betti numbers can depend on the field.
normalization: Betti numbers are those of the ideal rather than the quotient. The floor at one gives principal ideals and the zero-coordinate singleton slope one.
